deadline.value: Fall applications are due December 15, 2026 (same for international applicants).
deadline.quote: Applications for Fall are due December 15

gre_subject.value: No GRE is required, so no Chemistry subject test.

fee_waiver.value: The department pays the fee only for domestic applicants; an international waiver is possible only after the department reviews your file.
fee_waiver.quote: Possibly, but that will require a review of your application materials first

supervisor.value: No need to contact faculty first; admitted students get 10 weeks in Fall to find an advisor.
supervisor.quote: No, there is no need to contact faculty in advance.

funding.value: All admitted students start on a teaching assistantship; later funding depends on availability and good standing.
funding.quote: All students admitted to our program are funded initially on a teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: Apply with a bachelor's in chemistry or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants should have an undergraduate degree in chemistry or in a closely related field with a strong chemistry background.
